data.description: Sophisticated Living in Prestigious Jumeirah Garden City
data.display_address: Olivia Gardens Residence, Jumeirah Garden City, Al Satwa, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover a residence that combines elegant design with breathtaking views of Dubai’s skyline. This home offers a bright and airy ambiance, thanks to floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and showcase stunning cityscapes. The interiors feature top-tier finishes and an open layout that makes living and entertaining effortless.

The kitchen is outfitted with modern appliances and sophisticated cabinetry, perfectly complementing the stylish living and dining areas. Bathrooms are designed with attention to detail, featuring designer fixtures that elevate everyday comfort.

As a resident, you have access to an array of premium amenities, including rooftop pools, a cinema, co-working spaces, and secure parking. Situated within the vibrant Jumeirah Garden City community, this home offers an ideal blend of urban convenience and serene living.
